inspiration.observed_pattern: ATAN2 returns a signed angle from two numeric arguments, including a zero-axis case.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one positive-quadrant route and one east-axis route with independently authored coordinate values, retaining signed deltas and deterministic bearing projection.

fixture_notes: One route has positive north/east deltas and one has zero north delta, preserving quadrant and axis behavior with two rows.
determinism_notes: Route IDs, coordinates, origin constants, numeric expressions, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_route_points (route_id INT PRIMARY KEY, route_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, latitude DECIMAL(8,4) NOT NULL, longitude DECIMAL(8,4) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT route_id, ATAN2(latitude - 40.0000, longitude + 73.0000) AS bearing_radians FROM mini_route_points ORDER BY route_id
